description: Retired Polish Mi-2 delivered part-dismantled to the CKiW OHP grounds on 11 June 2013 and unveiled as a monument on 26 June 2013 on the initiative of Towarzystwo Bory Dolnośląskie. Presented in armed configuration with unguided rocket pods; green camouflage with Polish markings. Site is the former Soviet Northern Group of Forces airfield Szprotawa-Wiechlice held until 1992
